objective: Implement a deterministic point-in-time Momentum Family that emits one governed family-level TechnicalEvidence object from correlated return-momentum transforms without duplicate independent votes or trade authority.
scope: Define a governed Momentum Family policy
Validate a single-symbol single-timeframe trusted OHLCV momentum window with consistent dataset and quality lineage
Compute deterministic short-horizon and long-horizon rate-of-change
Compute deterministic horizon-normalized momentum acceleration context
Classify bullish, bearish or neutral momentum state using explicit symmetric thresholds
Emit exactly one MOMENTUM family-level TechnicalEvidence object with a single independence group
Bound strength and confidence as deterministic evidence scores rather than empirical probabilities
Reconcile P08-C task and lock state across GitHub and Linear
out_of_scope: Signal fusion, probability calibration, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none and active lock none before P08-C activation
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P08 source
Monotonic rising price path produces bullish momentum evidence
Monotonic falling price path produces bearish momentum evidence
Flat path produces neutral momentum evidence
Short and long momentum metrics and evidence identity are deterministic
Correlated momentum transforms emit one shared independence group and count as one confirmation
Strength/confidence remain bounded and are not represented as trade probability
P08-C evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No execution adapter or broker/exchange/order authority is imported
No network or credential access is required
rollback: Revert P08-C momentum module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and P08-C active-state reconciliation. P08-A/B remain canonical and no trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Momentum Family implemented with one family-level evidence output
Correlated return-momentum transforms do not create duplicate independent votes
Point-in-time and lineage invariants fail closed
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
